title: Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language agents that browse websites, operate phones and act in homes reason before every action, so every step waits for a large model, a latency and cost that stand in the way of deployment. Step-level speculation lets a small model draft each step and calls the large model only on rejected drafts, but its outcome rests on the judge, and a judge that reads only a step's text cannot tell whether the step fits the screen it acts on.
